content: The medication JT48, also known as JTT (Juzentaihoto), has specific dosing recommendations based on its indications. It is not explicitly specified for any particular condition but is considered potentially effective as an adjunct to chemotherapy. It may enhance the therapeutic effects of antineoplastic agents while reducing their adverse drug reactions (ADRs). No adverse effects have been reported in association with its use. The medication is contraindicated in individuals with hypersensitivity to its components. Regarding pregnancy, it is categorized as N/A, but it is generally considered acceptable for use. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. Information on its safety during lactation is also categorized as N/A. Details about its metabolism and excretion are not available. However, it is noted to have immunomodulatory properties, specifically with stimulatory effects.
